en-GB.description: A free email application that is easy to set up and customise - and it's loaded with great features!
en-GB.longDescription: Thunderbird is a free and open source email, newsfeed, chat, and calendaring client, that’s easy to set up and customise. One of the core principles of Thunderbird is the use and promotion of open standards - this focus is a rejection of our world of closed platforms and services that can’t communicate with each other. We want our users to have freedom and choice in how they communicate.

en-US.name: Mozilla Thunderbird (MSIX)
en-US.releaseNotes:
What’s New
new
Ctrl+A selects all filters in the Message Filters dialog
What’s Changed
changed
OAuth sign-in windows now explain when blocked cookies may prevent sign-in
changed
Office 365 account setup no longer automatically offers EWS configuration
What’s Fixed
fixed
The macOS Dock badge could omit unread counts with multiple accounts
fixed
Opening a window could cause Thunderbird to crash
fixed
Undo remained disabled after deleting messages, preventing their restoration
fixed
POP3 and news messages with LF line endings could be parsed incorrectly
fixed
The option to create a mailing list was missing from File > New
fixed
Restoring toolbar defaults unexpectedly closed the customization dialog
fixed
Thunderbird did not warn before repairing folders with offline message storage
fixed
Dragging multiple selected folders moved only one folder
fixed
Renaming or moving folders could remove them from saved searches
fixed
Replies to saved messages could be blocked despite a valid Reply-To address
fixed
The spelling dictionary menu was empty in the Subject field
fixed
Tabbing from Subject field focused the header divider instead of message body
fixed
Edit as New Message did not work for some news messages
fixed
Address book setup returned to mail setup when no mail account existed
fixed
Exchange autodiscovery failed when redirected to another email address
fixed
Empty message filter conditions could cause incorrect matches
fixed
Address book filter conditions failed to match messages with missing addresses
fixed
Address book website fields incorrectly prefixed non-HTTP links with HTTPS
fixed
Some CardDAV contacts with multiline street addresses appeared empty
fixed
CardDAV contacts were saved in a format unsupported by some servers
fixed
Photos saved in vCard 3.0 contacts could fail to appear in other clients
fixed
Windows system tray icon failed to update when new mail arrived
fixed
Processing some sender addresses could freeze new mail notifications
fixed
IMAP retention settings could delete newer messages instead of older ones
fixed
Message database updates could cause Thunderbird to crash
fixed
IMAP namespace root folders could be missing or have incorrect permissions
fixed
Graph account setup failed for tenants without a SharePoint license
fixed
Various News Reader improvements
fixed
IMAP folders could disappear after restart on servers using compression
fixed
Various Feed Reader improvements
fixed
Delete Event remained enabled for read-only calendars in the Today Pane
fixed
Attendance options were missing for some recurring event series
fixed
The task list stopped updating after toolbar customization
fixed
CalDAV reminders could not be dismissed or snoozed
fixed
Some webcal calendar subscriptions were incorrectly blocked
fixed
Invalid ICS calendar files could be overwritten when events were changed
fixed
Visual and UX improvements
fixed
Security fixes

zh-CN.author: Mozilla 基金会
zh-CN.description: Thunderbird 是一款免费的邮件应用程序，配置简单、定制自由、功能强大！
zh-CN.longDescription: Thunderbird 是一款免费开源的电子邮件、新闻订阅、即时通信、日历客户端，配置简单，定制自由。Thunderbird 的核心准则之一是使用和推广开放标准——重点就是拒绝世界上我们无法相互通信的封闭平台和服务。我们希望我们的用户在沟通方式上拥有自由和选择。
